newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen minister to visit Saudi over border dispute.
newsitem.headline: Yemen minister to visit Saudi over border dispute.

text.p: Yemen's Interior Minister Hussein Mohammad Arab is due to visit Saudi Arabia on Saturday carrying a message from President Ali Abdullah Saleh to King Fahd on a border row, an official source said on Friday.

The letter "deals with mutual consultations between the two countries' leaderships to resolve the border issue in addition to other issues including economic and security matters", the Yemeni source told Reuters.
Arab visited Saudi Arabia in late July and Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister Prince Nayef went to Yemen earlier that month as part of efforts towards resolving the dispute.
The border row dates back to the 1930s and has led to several minor clashes between the Arab world's richest oil power and one of its poorest states.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia signed a memorandum of understanding in 1995 in an attempt to end the row. Since then they have exchanged high-level visits and held joint meetings to resolve the issue.
